title: 上海高考高分翻译背诵-113-26二模

items.zh: 当饮食中的纤维比例失调时,营养就会受损。
items.en: Nutrition will be compromised when the fiber in the diet is out of proportion.

items.zh: 那块电子显示屏存在线路故障而危及公共安全,现已被拆除。
items.en: The electronic display whose faulty electrical wiring endangered public safety has now been dismantled.

items.zh: 从导演到舞台设计,每个学生在戏剧节上都各尽其能,使其才华在课堂外尽情绽放。
items.en: From the role of director to that of stage designer, each student did their utmost to let their talents bloom fully outside the classroom.

items.zh: 无论采取何种策略,其成效最终都应由它与学生日常体验及个人成长的相关性来衡量。
items.en: Whatever strategy is adopted, its effectiveness should ultimately be measured by its relevance to students’ daily experience and personal growth.
